evidence.text:
The Riverwardens maintain the ferry ropes and river warning lamps. Their emblem is a green heron. They are not the town guards.

The Cedarvale ferry connects the village to Reedbank. Ferryman Orin accepts copper market tokens. It carries carts on a broad timber deck.

The Lantern Crossing festival is held on the first autumn moon. Residents float paper boats carrying unlit candles along the mill channel.

Mira is the village blacksmith. Her forge stands beside the northern well. She repairs iron tools but does not sell healing potions.

Daren guards Stone Bridge. His duty is to inspect wagon permits at the bridge checkpoint. He cannot authorize private vault access.

Iona is Cedarvale's healer. Her clinic is behind the eastern gate. She treats burns with silverleaf salve.

Cedarvale's old stone bell commemorates the flood of Year Seven. Villagers moved grain stores uphill after that flood.

Elin keeps the Blue Lantern inn beside the western orchard. Travellers may rent its upstairs rooms. The inn serves barley soup.

The village library occupies the former watchtower. Archivist Tessa
